g.text: Recorded moderate preset only: xi=.85, sR=sF=4, M=40, p=7, rho=.75, kappa=.7 except the scanned parameter.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'STIXGeneral', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: The historical study has no controlled moderate sF sweep; its baseline sF data remain in Fig. 3. No missing scan is invented.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'STIXGeneral', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Top squares: activity. Curves and bands: medians/min–max over configurations; no transition order is inferred.
